title: Shark
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="body" cx="50%" cy="45%" r="55%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#3ec6e0"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#1a7fa8"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="belly" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#c8f0f8"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#8ad4e8"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="fin" x1="0" y1="1" x2="0" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#1a7fa8"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#2aa8cc"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- tail fin -->
  <polygon points="10,50 2,30 18,46 18,54 2,70" fill="url(#fin)"/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="52" cy="52" rx="38" ry="20" fill="url(#body)"/>

  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx="54" cy="62" rx="28" ry="10" fill="url(#belly)"/>

  <!-- dorsal fin -->
  <polygon points="40,33 48,14 58,34" fill="url(#fin)"/>

  <!-- pectoral fin -->
  <polygon points="46,64 38,80 56,68" fill="url(#fin)"/>

  <!-- snout highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="76" cy="46" rx="10" ry="7" fill="#5fdcef" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- eye white -->
  <circle cx="62" cy="44" r="5.5" fill="#e8faff"/>

  <!-- pupil -->
  <circle cx="63.5" cy="44" r="3" fill="#0d3b4f"/>

  <!-- eye glint -->
  <circle cx="64.5" cy="42.8" r="1.2" fill="#ffffff"/>

  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M78,54 Q72,62 62,60" fill="none" stroke="#0d3b4f" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- gill lines -->
  <path d="M48,42 Q46,48 48,55" fill="none" stroke="#1a7fa8" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M43,42 Q41,48 43,55" fill="none" stroke="#1a7fa8" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- teeth -->
  <polygon points="80,50 82,53 84,50" fill="#f0fbff"/>
  <polygon points="85,49 87,52 89,49" fill="#f0fbff"/>
  <polygon points="74,58 76,61 78,58" fill="#f0fbff"/>
  <polygon points="79,57 81,60 83,57" fill="#f0fbff"/>

  <!-- bubbles -->
  <circle cx="90" cy="34" r="2.5" fill="none" stroke="#8ad4e8" stroke-width="1"/>
  <circle cx="86" cy="26" r="1.8" fill="none" stroke="#8ad4e8" stroke-width="1"/>
  <circle cx="92" cy="22" r="1.2" fill="none" stroke="#8ad4e8" stroke-width="1"/>
</svg>
